title: automate-cert-rotation-hsm-kms-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private need automated, auditable rotation of TLS certificates and KMS keys across VPC/on-prem installers and Helm/Terraform managed clusters. Manual rotation is error-prone and blocks timely key rollover for compliance. This PR implements a coordinated automation pipeline that: 1) integrates with customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS and HSM-backed providers) for key material; 2) introduces a Vault-backed rotation mode that can generate short-lived certs and bootstrap sealed-secrets for cluster-level secrets; 3) adds Terraform modules and Helm hooks to apply new certs and rotate sealed secrets with minimal downtime; 4) includes an upgrade/rollback plan (canary + fast rollback) and e2e tests to validate drift-free rotation. Summary of changes: - private-installer: new rotation controller and CLI helper to trigger scheduled and ad-hoc rotations; supports HSM-backed signing via PKCS#11 and Cloud KMS via REST wrapper. - redwood-helm-charts: hooks to run pre-upgrade jobs to fetch new certs and post-upgrade validation jobs; chart values for sealed-secrets and vault integration. - redwood-terraform: modules for kms_key, hsm_provider, and vault_bootstrap that wire into the private installer outputs; examples for rolling key rotation with minimal resource churn. - docs: detailed runbook for rotation, troubleshooting and rollback steps. - tests: unit tests for the rotation controller, integration harness that runs in a KinD cluster using local Vault and mocked HSM. Backwards compatibility: the rotation controller defaults to disabled; existing clusters are unaffected until operators opt in or run the CLI helper. Security considerations: audit logs for rotation operations, RBAC bindings for rotation controller, and strict KMS-enforced key policies. Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation and unit tests - [x] Helm hooks and chart changes - [x] Terraform module with examples - [x] End-to-end integration test in CI - [x] Documentation and runbook - [x] Migration/rollback plan - [x] Ops automation for scheduled rotations Notes: The description compresses several sections into one continuous field to keep the PR body machine-readable. See changed_files for a high-level list of modified components and review_comments for threads and approvals.
